content: Hi @Ben Eltschig , I came across #31141 where the result ContDiffOn.parametric_integral is useful to something I'm working on. The PR has been idle since February, may I ask would it be possible to get this across the finishing line since it has basically been reviewed and approved, with only a few comments left from @Floris van Doorn . If you don't mind I could also try to adopt the PR to finish this (I'm not sure what's the etiquette for doing so.)

The "31141" rung a bell with me, or maybe it was the "parametric_integral", and indeed I found a reference to it in work of one or another of my LLMs on a special functions project where parametric integrals are seen all the time. As my LLM explained it to me: "Michael Rothgang's open PR #30610, originating in sphere-eversion, and peabrainiac's open PR #31141 develop convenient differentiability/smoothness results for parametric interval integrals. TauCeti's Analysis/Calculus/ParametricIntegral.lean also proves integrability and differentiation for integrable weights over compact parameter spaces." So I too would welcome seeing #31141 get across the finishing line.
Bumping this, would it be reasonable to create a new PR that continues on the branch history?
I would just leave Ben a week or two to reply before you do so
